Do you want to work for an organization that is dynamic, goal-driven, and dedicated to making a difference? Welcome to Welthungerhilfe! Welthungerhilfe (WHH) is one of Germany’s largest private aid organizations. Politically and religiously independent, we work toward a world without hunger. Together with national and international partners, we respond to humanitarian crises and support long-term solutions that improve the living conditions for the most vulnerable people. We change and shape food systems, we are locally-led and globally connected. As an impact-oriented and human-centered organization, we use innovation, evidence and data-informed decision-making to continuously improve our work and contribute to #Zero Hunger. Our vision: "Zero Hunger on a Healthy Planet." Join us in creating a world where everyone has access to food while ensuring a sustainable future for our planet. If you are ready to make an impact, we look forward to receiving your application! Country Director Sudan* in Khartoum The position is to be filled as soon as possible, with an initial contract duration of one year. There are very good prospects for an extension. Employment location will be Khartoum, Sudan should security situation allow. Otherwise the Country office is based on Port Sudan. Welthungerhilfe (WHH) is present in Sudan since 1982, and is currently implementing projects in North Darfur, Kassala, Gedaref, River Nile and Red Sea States. In line with our global mandate to Fight Hunger, WHH focuses in Sudan on Humanitarian Assistance and WASH as well as on strengthening climate resilient agriculture, natural resource management and economic development of rural communities and IDPs. As Country Director Sudan, you will lead an impact-oriented country programme spanning humanitarian assistance and long-term development. You will ensure alignment with WHH's global strategy, quality standards, Code of Conduct, organizational values, and partnership principles. You will represent WHH in relevant humanitarian and development forums, strengthen strategic partnerships, lead resource mobilization and donor engagement, and secure new funding opportunities. In Sudan's highly complex operating environment, you will provide strategic leadership across programme quality, organizational performance, security, people management, and operational effectiveness. As part of the WHH Global Leadership Team you will contribute to organizational leadership and continuous improvement of our work globally, regionally and within Sudan. Your responsibilities Provide strategic leadership and overall management of WHH’s country programme in a complex and evolving context. Lead high-quality humanitarian and development programming, driving innovation and the implementation of WHH’s Food Systems Approach. Ensure the financial sustainability of the country programme through effective and efficient resource management, financial stewardship and resource mobilization. Continue to diversify the funding basis of the country program, including new, innovative institutional and private donors willing to support with longer term funding. Lead and manage a diverse team in a complex, challenging context, giving special attention to (national) staff development. Lead and develop a high-performing Senior Management Team, fostering a culture of accountability, learning, innovation and adherence to WHH’s values and Code of Conduct. Ensure effective risk management, safeguarding, security, duty of care and business continuity. Forge and maintain strong relationships with other international and national organizations and continue to expand outreach through relevant meetings, workshops, and conferences. Continue to identify strategically relevant partners (CSO, research, local government, international NGOs etc.) to be supportive in achieving program objectives. Serve as the organization’s legal representative in Sudan. Support a culture of learning and openness to identify and analyze weaknesses in project/program implementation and take the necessary steps to overcome them. Analyze the adequateness of WHH Sudan program capacities and structure against the continuously changing context and WHH strategic objectives and take measures to adjust as necessary. Your profile Significant senior leadership experience in fragile and conflict-affected contexts. Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams. Experience in remote management of such teams. Demonstrated systems leadership, connecting strategy, programmes, finance, operations, partnerships and people to achieve sustainable organizational performance in complex environments. Proven experience leading organizational change, transformation and crisis response. Extensive experience managing integrated humanitarian and development portfolios. Strong track record in resource mobilization, business development and organizational sustainability. Strong external representation and strategic communication skills, with the ability to articulate WHH’s positions confidently and credibly to government, donors, partners, media and the wider public. Full professional proficiency of English is essential. Arabic language skills would be an asset. What we offer Fair Compensation: A fair and equal remuneration based on a transparent salary scale. Commitment to Well-Being: We attach great importance to our duty of care with a focus on safety, security & health. Modern & Agile Work Environment: Be part of a forward thinking organization that fully embraces digitalization and innovation across all areas. Personal & Professional Growth: Access diverse learning and development opportunities to advance your career. Team: Join our dedicated and diverse teams, where passion, expertise, and joy come together to create a better world. In addition, Welthungerhilfe offers numerous other benefits, which you can find under Our benefits . Please send your application via our online recruiting system by October 20, 2026. Your contact person is Ina Stepka. Welthungerhilfe is committed to fighting terrorism in all its activities. Accordingly, any applicant who is offered employment will be screened against lists of known and suspected terrorists. Welthungerhilfe values diversity and ensures an inclusive, non-discriminatory working environment. We welcome applications from suitably qualified people from all sections of the community. Our Benefits Find Out What Benefits Welthungerhilfe Offers For Employees. Our Projects We fight against hunger and poverty by implementing projects in numerous countries. review_candidates.description: About Us ATOSS Software SE is one of Germany’s most successful tech growth stories. We’re a rare company: according to Handelsblatt (10/24), just 309 public companies worldwide achieved over 20% return on sales for ten consecutive years. Only one based in Germany: ATOSS Software SE. With 20 years of record breaking growth, over €2 billion market cap, and listings in SDAX and TecDAX, we’re scaling globally and we’re growing. If you’re ready to drive impact in a high-performing B2B SaaS environment, this is your chance to elevate your career. We Value Those Who Think like entrepreneurs – taking ownership, pushing boundaries, and driving impact. Challenge the status quo – bringing fresh ideas and bold execution to the table. Thrive in change – seeing growth as a lifelong journey, both professionally and personally. We don’t just equip you for work—we prepare you for life The Role As a Cloud Ops Engineer in our Cloud Operations Services (COS) department, you get hands-on experience with CI/CD, automation, and cloud operations for the ATOSS Cloud Solution, across Azure and T Cloud Public. You build and maintain pipelines and scripts alongside senior engineers, and grow into deploying and operating cloud and AI services. You work closely with R&D, Cloud Architecture, and the other COS engineers. Key Responsibilities CI/CD & delivery pipelines Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for infrastructure, deployments, and operational tasks. Contribute to standardizing pipeline patterns across teams: build, test, deploy, rollback. Apply GitOps practices so changes are declarative and auditable. Automation & scripting Automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle operations with Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Write and maintain scripts and small tools (Python, Bash, PowerShell) that remove manual work from daily operations. Turn recurring manual tasks into pipelines, scripts, or self-service workflows. Cloud architecture & service operations Deploy and maintain Azure services and their counterparts on T Cloud Public, from managed platform services to compute and networking. Contribute to reusable templates and patterns for product teams. AI infrastructure & AI operations Deploy and operate the AI services behind our products and internal AI initiatives, such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI endpoints. Treat AI components like any other production service: provisioned through IaC, deployed through pipelines, and monitored. Help track capacity, quotas, and cost visibility for AI operations. Experience with or a strong interest in cloud services on Azure and/or T Cloud Public. Willingness to learn how to weigh trade-offs between different services and approaches. Curiosity about AI infrastructure and AI services. Clear communication with technical and non-technical colleagues; a pragmatic, eager-to-learn mindset. Fluent English; German is a plus. Nice to have / Plus Python and Django experience. Familiarity with Kafka or similar streaming platforms. Basic exposure to AI platform concepts (model serving, vector databases, AI observability). Relevant certifications (Azure, CKA/CKAD) or coursework in progress.
